guest.heading: Welcome Back
guest.subheading: Continue your learning journey with us. Knowledge is the key to success.

auth.forgotHelp: Forgot your password? No problem. Just let us know your email address and we will email you a password reset link that will allow you to choose a new one.
auth.resetLinkSent: A password reset link has been sent to your email address.
auth.confirmHelp: This is a secure area of the application. Please confirm your password before continuing.
auth.verifyHelp: Thanks for signing up! Before getting started, could you verify your email address by clicking on the link we just emailed to you? If you didn't receive the email, we will gladly send you another.
auth.verifySent: A new verification link has been sent to the email address you provided during registration.

profile.title: Profile
profile.informationHelp: Update your account's profile information and email address.
profile.resendVerificationLink: Click here to re-send the verification email.
profile.verificationSent: A new verification link has been sent to your email address.
profile.passwordHelp: Ensure your account is using a long, random password to stay secure.
profile.deleteHelp: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will be permanently deleted. Before deleting your account, please download any data or information that you wish to retain.
profile.deleteConfirmTitle: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
profile.deleteConfirmHelp: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will be permanently deleted. Please enter your password to confirm you would like to permanently delete your account.

studentLogin.title: Trainee sign in
studentLogin.heading: Trainee Area
studentLogin.codeHelp: Enter the code given to you by your driving school.

student.title: My space
student.notEnrolled: Your account is not linked to a trainee file yet.
student.notEnrolledHelp: Ask your driving school to complete your registration. Your appointments and exam results will appear here.
student.emptyHelp: Your appointments and exam results will appear here as soon as your driving school schedules them.

users.title: Administrators
users.subtitle: Accounts that can manage the school.
users.createHelp: They sign in with this email and password.
users.editHelp: Leave the password empty to keep the current one.
users.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
users.deleteHelp: {{name}} loses access immediately and this cannot be undone.
users.emptyHelp: Adjust the search or the filters.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Licence categories trainees can be enrolled in
categories.createHelp: The code is what appears on the trainee file, so keep it short.
categories.editHelp: Changing the code does not affect trainees already enrolled.
categories.codeHelp: For example A, B, C or AC.
categories.iconHelp: JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 2 MB.
categories.deleteHelp: Category {{code}} will be removed. This is only possible while no trainee uses it.
categories.deleteConfirmCode: Type the category code to unlock deletion.
categories.emptyHelp: Create the first licence category to start enrolling trainees.

questions.title: Question bank
questions.subtitle: Theory questions trainees are examined on, in Arabic and French
questions.question: Question
questions.label: Label
questions.previewTitle: How the trainee sees this question
questions.previewHelp: Same screen, same buttons: choose an answer, then valider.
questions.emptyHelp: Create the first one and it becomes available to every exam.
questions.deleteHelp: Question #{{id}} and its image and audio files are removed for good.
questions.createHelp: Write it in one language if you like: the other one takes the same wording.
questions.editHelp: Changes apply to every exam that already uses this question.
questions.choicesHelp: Fill them in order starting at 1: two choices are enough, leave 3 and 4 empty to drop them.
questions.settingsHelp: The category is the only field that may stay empty.
questions.categoryHelp: Leave it empty to keep the question unassigned for now.
questions.timeHelp: Seconds the trainee gets for this question, 1 to 600.
questions.langHelp: One language is enough: the empty one copies the wording you typed.
questions.correctHint: Click a number to mark the right answer.

students.title: Trainees
students.subtitle: Trainee files, enrolment and history.
students.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, file number, CIN, phone or login code
students.examLanguageHelp: The language the trainee sits the theory exam and reads the questions in.
students.contactHelp: How the trainee reaches the school and signs in.
students.phoneHelp: The number the school reaches the trainee on.
students.lessonsCountHelp: Squares the clickable bar on the file page gets.
students.lessonsNone: Click a square to fill the lessons done so far
students.entryDateHelp: The day the trainee joined the school.
students.loginCodeNote: This is the code the trainee types to sign in.
students.codeNotStored: Assigned before codes could be shown. Set one to make it visible.
students.loginCodeHelp: Letters or digits, 3 characters minimum. It is what the trainee types to sign in, e.g. 123 or EC-2026-0002.
students.loginCodeKeep: Leave empty to keep the current code.
students.photoHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 2 MB.
students.createHelp: The trainee signs in with the login code set here.
students.editHelp: Update the information held on this trainee.
students.noCategories: No licence category is active yet. Create one before adding a trainee.
students.deleteHelp: {{name}} and the linked sign-in account are removed permanently.
students.deleteConfirmCode: Type the login code to unlock deletion.
students.deleteConfirmNumber: This file has no login code: type its file number instead.
students.emptyHelp: Create the first file to get started.
